name: ikik-api
description: 基于 Sub2API 二开的 AI API 网关与订阅管理平台，包含共享私有账号池、拼车池、免费模型清单、让Claude、Openai、Gemini、Grok、Kiro 订阅统一接入，原生工具无缝使用。

capability_evidence.model-routing: way endpoints for chat, responses, models, embeddings, image, and streaming workloads.
capability_evidence.quota-distribution: oarding, and configurable private-account access flows.
capability_evidence.billing-metering: a self-hosted AI API gateway and subscription management platform based on Sub2API.
capability_evidence.self-hosted: a resets, service interruptions, upstream policy changes, and billing errors are operational risks that must be handled by the deployer.
capability_evidence.gui-desktop: clients that send headers containing underscores, enable underscore headers in the Nginx http block:

friction.note_en: Involved setup. needs make build; configure API key configuration, config file
friction.note_zh: 配置较重。需要 make build；需配置 API key configuration、config file

analysis.summary_en: ikik-api is a self-hosted AI API gateway and subscription management platform based on Sub2API.
highlights: Merged upstream sub2api v0.2.4 (519 commits / 876 files) and unified the frontend and backend versions at 1.0.4.
Upgraded the backend toolchain to Go 1.26.5 and refreshed vulnerable AWS SDK dependencies used by storage integrations.
API key management with multi-group routing, IP access controls, quota controls, usage records, and billing metadata.
Grok OAuth, Kiro OAuth, free-model provider onboarding, and configurable private-account access flows.
analysis.summary_zh_native: ikik-api 是基于 Sub2API 二次开发的自托管 AI API 网关与订阅管理平台，提供账号池、API Key 管理、多供应商请求转发、用量计费、订阅充值、风控审查和后台运营能力。
highlights_zh: 支持 Grok OAuth、Kiro OAuth、免费模型供应商接入和可配置的私有账号接入流程。
API Key 管理，支持多分组路由、IP 访问控制、额度控制、使用记录和计费元数据。
内置发布流程，支持标签构建、Docker 镜像、归档包和 GitHub Releases。
提供 OpenAI 兼容网关接口，支持 chat、responses、models、embeddings、image 和流式请求等场景。
